name: Microsoft Graph Calendar
tagline: Outlook and Exchange calendars via Microsoft Graph REST API
description: Microsoft Graph Calendar is the REST surface for Outlook and Exchange Online calendars. Developers list calendars, create and update events, check free/busy, and manage attendees through the Graph API using Microsoft Entra ID authentication. A free Microsoft 365 developer tenant is available for building and testing without production paid mailboxes.

auth.details: Microsoft Entra ID OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect. Register an app in Entra ID, request calendar permissions (e.g. Calendars.Read, Calendars.ReadWrite), and send Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN. Delegated or application (client credentials) flows supported.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Microsoft Graph is included with Microsoft 365 / Entra ID tenancy; free Microsoft 365 Developer Program sandbox tenant for development. No per-call Graph fee for standard calendar endpoints; usage subject to tenant licensing and Graph throttling.
pricing.paid_plans: Requires appropriate Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online licenses for user mailboxes; Azure AD app registration free. Enterprise Microsoft 365 plans apply for production tenants.

rate_limits: Service-specific throttling; calendar/Outlook commonly limited (e.g. tens of thousands of requests per 10 minutes per app per tenant patterns documented). Honor Retry-After on HTTP 429. Exact fixed public quota for calendar varies by resource — see Graph throttling guidance.
use_cases: list upcoming Outlook calendar events for the signed-in user
create a meeting with attendees on an Exchange Online calendar
update or cancel an existing calendar event
list a user's calendars and switch default calendar
find events in a date range via calendarView
